Messages.Author: Malachy
Messages.Body:
Heys!

How does Loki's Gift interacts with cards like Restricted Vitae, Sunset Strip, Hollywood, XTC-Laced Blood and all the cards referring to hunt actions? (I know for sure that Strained Vitae Supply does not reduce LG's stealth cuz it has been ruled in one of my previous posts)

(Too many cards mentioned, I exluded copying texts)

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Malachy wrote:
> Heys!
>
> How does Loki's Gift interacts with cards like Restricted Vitae, Sunset Strip, Hollywood, XTC-Laced Blood and all the cards referring to hunt actions? (I know for sure that Strained Vitae Supply does not reduce LG's stealth cuz it has been ruled in one of my previous posts)
>
> (Too many cards mentioned, I exluded copying texts)
>
If Sunset Strip is in play, and is tapped, Loki's Gift gets an extra +1 stealth.
XTC-Laced Blood is usable on the Loki's Gift action, and the mandatory hunt action of a vampire with XTC-Laced Blood can be a Loki's Gift.
Other important ones: Aaron's Feeding Razor won't burn an extra blood from the target of suprior Loki's Gift.
If Zöe / Igo the Hungry played Loki's Gift, it would be a +1 steatlh action (their ability only affects the normal stealth when hunting, which refers to the stealth when performing the regular hunt action - same for Strained Vitae Supply).
If Le Dinh To played Loki's Gift, it would be a 0 stealth action (because he gets -1 stealth when hunting, whatever the action is).
Kyoko can play Loki's Gift.

checking Restricted Vitae

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Pascal wrote:
> checking Restricted Vitae
>
Restricted Vitae restricts any hunt action from being taken, except when forced.

When you are forced, you can take alternate hunt actions.

[LSJ 20050729]
>
> LSJ wrote:
> > Met A is playing with Ravnos. Week of Nightmares and Restricted Vitae
> > are in play.
> >
> > 1. The Ravnos can't hunt until reaches zero blood (per Restricted
> > Vitae). When that happens, which options do he have to hunt? I suppose
> > he can either steal a blood from other Ravnos at +1 stelth OR steal a
> > blood from a younger vampire with 0 stealth. Is that correct?
>
> Yes.
>
[LSJ 20090508]
>
> LSJ wrote:
> > if i have a Restricted vitae in play and an empty Laibon, can i play
> > earth feeder and declare a hunt on a younger vampire controlled by
> > another methuselah ?
> > (my guess : yes)
>
> No. Choose one action or the other.
>
Beware the "no" because the question is about something subtly different i.e. do the two stack. But it confirms you can use an Earth-feeder to hunt.

The end result is that - under Restricted Vitae - you cannot play Loki's Gift until you are forced to hunt. (Typically by being empty.) When you are forced to hunt, you can take a Loki's Gift hunt action, or any other hunt action available to you.

Messages.Body:
> Reyda wrote:
> To be honnest : When you look at the card text of le din tho, the only difference seems not in designer's intent (various hunt actions did not exist at that point) but more as a shorter wording to save space.
>
Possibly, but card text is what it is. And the issue has been ruled on, explicitly, in the past.  [LSJ 20081203]

Alternate hunt actions don't get the usual +1 stealth. For example, Restricted Vitae gives you a zero-stealth  action. (Confirmed above, in the Week of Nightmares v RV ruling.) So it's not a usual stealth applied to all hunt actions, just the default one. Alternate hunt actions define their own stealth (or lack thereof).

So at that point, we just follow the card text.
